name: Texas Pro Se Legal Matters
tagline: Case organisation for Texans representing themselves, from trial court to appeal
description: Each matter gets its own home, with hearing dates, nudges when something needs serving, and a shelf that keeps one case's papers away from another's. It spans the district and appellate levels up to the state's highest court, and it states plainly that it informs rather than represents you.
